free_text_notes.physician_note: 80-year-old man with former smoker (40 pack-years), anxiety, admitted 3/20 with acute exacerbation of COPD. Weaned from BiPAP on day 2; now on room air at rest.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. Pulmonology has not seen the patient yet. A slight elevation in liver enzymes was noted on day 1. The test was repeated on day 3 and the result returned to normal. No action is needed.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and son to review the discharge plan. 3/23 18:00: Per pharmacy, prednisone taper: 30 mg x3 days, then 20 mg x3 days, then stop (was 40 mg daily). No documentation that the patient or family has been informed of the new dose. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead.
